utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mara, just wanted to let you know the repair drive's in the west lot this weekend—and Sunday afternoon we'll be painting and landscaping if you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great to know, Tess! I'm meeting folks at the community center Saturday at 10 AM to organize tools and supplies—sounds like we'll be all set for Sunday too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Awesome, Mara! Sounds like you've got it all under control. I'll see you Saturday morning to help organize.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, it's this Saturday at the community center. You should come!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'm already planning to go! I heard it's at 10 AM—does that match what you saw?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I think that's right. I'm not totally sure though—I just caught that it was Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm a bit confused about the time—some say 9, others 10. Do you know for sure?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Ha! With Oren in charge, I wouldn't bet on any time—he can't even remember the date.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: True, Oren's a bit scatterbrained. Maybe I'll just aim for 9 and wait around.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Leo! I'm heading to the repair drive this Sunday afternoon for painting and landscaping. Want to come along?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, what time exactly?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm planning to be there around 1 PM, after the kids' soccer games. Sound good?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Pia, I heard you're involved with the repair drive. Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, thanks Sam! I'm just worried about the logistics—do you think we'll have enough tools and a proper schedule?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Don't worry, Pia! I've checked—Eli said we have enough tools, and Faye's handling painting and landscaping on Sunday. We've got a good plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I have it sorted now—west lot on the 15th, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No, Oren, it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4, fixing electronics and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the community center! I must've mixed up my notes. Thanks for setting me straight, Vik.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sounds like you're up to speed on the repair drive too. I'm glad we're all pulling together for this.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Dane, I've got it marked on my calendar for the 15th in the west lot. Glad to have everyone on board.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, the 15th in the west lot? I thought Vik said it was this Saturday at the community center. Did the plans change?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I heard about the repair drive. I've got a bunch of tools in my garage if you need to borrow any.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus! I heard about it from Quinn—I'd love to borrow your tools for the park benches.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I'm happy to help! I'll bring them over to the community center on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Noah, I've been hearing about the repair drive from Mara and Mina. Can you tell me more about what exactly is planned?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, um, I think it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4? Something like that, but I'm not totally sure on the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah. I'll double-check with Mara to confirm the exact time and location.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Quinn! I'm glad you're here. I've been tallying supplies for the repair drive—we're a bit short on nails, but we've got plenty of paint.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great job, Cleo! Let's see if anyone else can bring nails—I'll ask around at the block party tonight.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be perfect, Quinn! Thanks for spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the repair drive? I'm still figuring out the details myself. What do you need to know?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's in the west lot on the 15th. I always double-check the map.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Right, the west lot on the 15th. I should write that down so I don't forget.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Ah, meeting people... I suppose.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It's actually this Sunday now from 10 to 4 at the community center. There'll be coffee and snacks too!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I see. I might stop by for a bit, depending on how things go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope the repair drive has a clear schedule and enough supplies. Do you know if they've got that sorted?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, we're meeting at the community center at 10 AM on Saturday to plan everything. There's a shortage of nails, but Gus is bringing extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's good to hear about the tools, but a shortage of nails sounds worrying. Are we going to get more before Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Vik, I heard about the repair drive. It sounds like a good way to help out the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's this Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center. Cleo's bringing the tools, and Dane's checking supplies—should be a good turnout!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, thanks for confirming the time. I was going to double-check on the flyer, but that matches.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Jules, to make sure I have this right, could you walk me through what a repair drive typically involves?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure! People bring in broken items like electronics, clothes, or furniture, and volunteers with skills help fix them. It's a great way to reduce waste and learn something new. Want to come along this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds great, Jules. Can you tell me what time it starts and what I should bring if I want to help?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Bo, just a heads up—the repair drive is this weekend, but it's in the west lot, not by the park like I thought. Are you planning to come?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the west lot? Got it. I might swing by if I have time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I hope you can make it! We'll be painting and landscaping on Sunday, so there's plenty to do.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Cleo, what kind of supplies have you gathered so far?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got plenty of tools in my garage if you need to borrow any, Mina.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. What do you have that might be useful for fixing fences and gates?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Opal! I'm glad I ran into you. The repair drive has been moved to this Sunday at the community center—same great idea, just a different day.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, Rosa, I'm pretty sure it's still the 15th in the west lot. I just double-checked the map earlier.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, no, Opal – it got moved! Just checked with Vik, it's now Sunday at the community center from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I just wondered when it might start, but maybe I should check the notice board again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I'm not sure either. I think I heard 10, but then someone said 9... maybe we should both check the notice board.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, let's go check it together, then.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the park benches and could use your help spreading the word!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard about it! But I'm a little confused on the time—first I thought 9, then Jules said 10. I'll probably just show up early to be safe.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, it's at 9 AM, so showing up early sounds perfect! Thanks for joining in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hello Sam. I was just trying to remember where I put that list for the repair drive... I think it might be in my other coat.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Oren. Want me to check your other coat with you?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That would be great, Sam. I think I left it in the left pocket.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Well, we're good on paint, but we're running low on nails. I've got the full list here if you want to see.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, thanks Cleo. Let me take a look at that list — I might have some extra nails in my garage.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be great, Faye! Let me know what you find, and I'll update the list accordingly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Lost the note? That's not very reassuring. Are we sure this is actually happening?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'm pretty sure it's at 9, but let me double-check online.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, but I'm not bringing my stuff until I see an official announcement.
